name: Local Search
description: Search the offline library (local Wikipedia ZIM archives + the user's notes and documents). Returns compact results: id | title | snippet. Read a full document with local_read(id).

query.description: Search terms or an article title

lang.description: Wikipedia edition only, e.g. 'en', 'it'. Default: all

path.description: Alternative folder or file to search. Default: the shared library
